bio: Some establishments just know how to warm the cockles of one’s heart and Hof Ter Hulst is one such. The delightful Campine farmhouse has morphed into a characterful venue and as soon as you set foot inside the door, you understand that Johan Schroven doesn’t mess around with tradition, as his rich score demonstrates. The first bite of the langoustine, which is crafted with textbook precision, bears witness to the outstanding quality of the ingredients, further enhanced by a refreshing zest of lemon, without forgetting a creamy oxtail stew, truffles and a rich gravy that complete this exquisite surf and turf dish.
